name: Display Adjustment
description:
Offers sliders to control external displays' brightness and contrast through DDC. Extension requires ddcutil-service to be installed.
Installation process of ddcutil-service is quick and non-intrusive. The details can be found at https://gitlab.com/w8jcik/display-adjustment#installation-of-ddcutil-service. ddcutil-service allows more responsive communication with the displays than ddcutil.
